svg.title: Two routes to a family insurance policy
svg.desc: A family buys for multiple members. Affina Pro sales staff fill data, prepare the order and send it to the buyer, who confirms. On the Web App, the customer fills data, selects a plan and completes their information. Both routes continue to payment and a family policy.
